video_title: Enough Is Enough! Jaylen Brown, I Accept Your Challenge

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith defends ESPN against Jaylen Brown's unethical claims
quotes.excerpt: The second we don't like what you said because we think it is counterintuitive and counterproductive to your affiliation
quotes.quote: The second we don't like what you said because we think it is counterintuitive and counterproductive to your affiliation with the Boston Celtics and your association and your connection to Boston Celtics fans, suddenly we're unethical because we're telling you how your comments came across.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith highlights Jaylen Brown's accolades and on-court greatness
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen Brown is an NBA champion. He's an NBA Finals MVP and an Eastern Conference Finals MVP
quotes.quote: Jaylen Brown is an NBA champion. He's an NBA Finals MVP and an Eastern Conference Finals MVP. He is somebody that I can show you sound after sound after sound of me raving about this man, not just his play but his character.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith details Jaylen Brown's historic performance for the Celtics
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen Brown is only one of three players in the history of the Boston Celtics
quotes.quote: Jaylen Brown has been playing like an MVP candidate all year. Jaylen Brown is only one of three players in the history of the Boston Celtics to average 28 points, six rebounds, five assists. Only Larry Bird and John Havlicek have done that in Boston Celtics history.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith criticizes Jaylen Brown's playoff loss to the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: You had a 3-1 lead and you gave up the 3-1 lead to lose to the Philadelphia 76ers
quotes.quote: Twenty-four hours after getting bounced out in the first round where you had a 3-1 lead and you gave up the 3-1 lead to lose to the Philadelphia 76ers with a hobbled, injured Joel Embiid leading the way against you along with Tyrese Maxey. And I said that to say 24 hours later to call that your favorite season, I'm unethical?

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith addresses Jaylen Brown's challenge for a debate
quotes.excerpt: You challenged me to a debate and I said to you I was happy to sit down with you
quotes.quote: You challenged me to a debate and I said to you I was happy to sit down with you, but it makes no sense because we just sat down together face-to-face a year ago right here on my show. I flew to Boston to see you and you were kind enough to give me your time and to sit down with me.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith discusses Boston's potential interest in trading Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: That's one of the reasons Boston is looking to move you. They aren't looking to trade you
quotes.quote: Because of that, Boston, that's one of the reasons Boston is looking to move you. They aren't looking to trade you. They weren't ready to move you up out here for Giannis. They aren't on the phones with several teams right now now that Giannis is going to Miami.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith calls for Jaylen Brown to take accountability
quotes.excerpt: What you need to stop doing is passing the buck of accountability and owning that shit yourself
quotes.quote: What you need to stop doing is passing the buck of accountability and owning that shit yourself. When you going to be accountable for what you say and what you do? All I did was quote you, as did everybody else on ESPN, FS1, NBC, Prime, or whoever else. We quoted you. You said it.
